title: Prioritizing global equity in migration research
core_idea: The study compiles a large Scopus-based bibliometric corpus of migration-related scholarship and analyzes its content to identify thematic, geographic, and demographic gaps and to assess how factors such as research investment and geographic location relate to countries' representation, aiming to inform more equitable research priorities and resource allocation in migration studies.
tldr: Uses Scopus bibliometrics to map disparities and representation in global migration scholarship and to guide efforts toward greater equity in research.
